description: Paid: $0.03 USDC on Base per call, paid automatically by an x402-capable MCP client. No signup, no API key. Returns the whole crawl policy of one public http(s) URL's origin, from ONE robots.txt fetch: every group, every rule with its line number in the file, which group governs each well-known agent and why, sitemaps resolved to absolute URLs, and two digests (robots_txt_sha256, policy_hash) to watch a policy for changes with one cheap call. An unanalysable URL is never charged for (error target_not_analysable). The free tool robots_check answers one agent's allow/disallow decision for one URL, for nothing. Argument: url.

url.description: Public http(s) URL to analyse. Must be reachable from the internet; private, loopback and link-local addresses are refused (target_not_analysable) and are never charged for.
